newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil slightly lower on poor leads.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil slightly lower on poor leads.

text.p: The Malaysian palm oil market eased slightly in early trading with falls in Chicago soyoil futures overnight and lack of directions dampening sentiment, traders said.
"The market was slightly down this morning. Prices movements were still stuck in a tight range," a trader said, adding lack of major players in the market limited activity.
At 0335 GMT June futures contract eased two ringgit to 1,237 ringgit ($493.22) a tonne, and traders expect it to trade in a 1,230 and 1,250 ringgit range.
